lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spot clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal dermal ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical gradients with high-luminance peaks and shadowed troughs.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch or indentation on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region beneath the pectoral fin.
